;Disasters and accidents
*A fire at a hospital kills five patients being treated for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]]. No cause for the fire has been determined. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bangladesh-hospital-fire/bangladesh-hospital-fire-kills-five-coronavirus-patients-idUSKBN2332UZ (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Hong Kong–United States relations]], [[2019–20 Hong Kong protests]]
**[[United States Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] tells [[United States Congress|Congress]] that [[Hong Kong]] is "no longer autonomous from [[China]]" following [[Beijing]]'s plans to impose a new security law on the territory, and no longer meets its special designation for trade under U.S. law that was established in the [[United States–Hong Kong Policy Act]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52824839 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[George Floyd protests]]
**[[George Floyd protests in Minnesota]]
***[[Riot]]ing and [[looting]] take place in [[Minneapolis]], [[Minnesota]], [[United States]], following the [[Murder of George Floyd|death]] of [[African Americans|African-American]] man [[George Floyd]] during his arrest by [[Minneapolis Police Department]] officers. Several buildings are looted and burned down, and [[riot police]] have been deployed. [https://www.foxnews.com/us/minneapolis-protests-looting-george-floyd-death (Fox News)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/conflict-erupts-minneapolis-l-protests-over-george-floyd-death-n1216096 (NBC News)]
***A 43-year-old protester is shot dead outside a pawnshop. The shooting is carried out by the owner of the shop. He is arrested. [https://m.startribune.com/man-shot-dead-outside-lake-street-pawnshop-during-unrest-is-identified/570865962/ (''Star Tribune'')]
*[[Kyoto Animation arson attack]]
**In [[Kyoto]], Japan, [[Kyoto Animation arson attack#Suspect|Shinji Aoba]] is arrested. He was moved from the hospital and charged for an arson attack at an [[Kyoto Animation|animation center]] in July 2019, which killed 36 people. Aoba had been unable to be arrested due to the severe injuries he sustained during the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-fire-arrests/man-arrested-over-deadly-2019-arson-at-japans-kyoto-animation-idUSKBN23303U (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-52813523 (BBC News)]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]], [[crime in Florida]]
**The May 24 arrest of a 23-year-old man in [[Tampa]], [[Florida]], is announced by federal prosecutors. He had allegedly been planning a [[mass shooting]] at [[Honeymoon Island State Park]] in support of [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIS]]. [https://www.wtsp.com/article/news/crime/tampa-shooting-plot-isis/67-98461c1e-73cc-4a9f-94c2-d5d9219fe502 (WTSP)]
*[[Essex lorry deaths]]
**Judicial authorities in [[Belgium]] and [[France]] announce the arrest of 26 suspects, followed 16 simultaneous early morning raids on 26 May in [[Brussels]] and [[Paris]], which targeted the “notably suspected” [[organized crime|organization]] believed to be responsible for the tragedy in the [[U.K.]] [https://www.nydailynews.com/news/world/ny-26-arrests-deaths-vietnamese-migrants-20200528-cz3p7tyz4rcsdikfrdmt4gwody-story.html (''Daily News'')]
*[[Zambia Police Service|Zambian police]] arrest three people suspected of [[murder]]ing three [[Chinese people|Chinese]] nationals three days prior and burning their bodies. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-52805202 (BBC News)]
